structured_files.scope: Full XML traversal into local inventory; selected filtering/drop-target attributes and ancestor chain inspected, other elements pending review.

findings: MinSizeBox binds MinimumFileLength two-way through BytesToKilobytesConverter, with integer display N0, minimum zero and maximum Int64.MaxValue interpreted as kilobytes. ConvertBack multiplies Int64 by 1024; sufficiently large allowed input can overflow. Runtime binding error presentation remains untested.

Included/excluded directory ListBoxes allow drag/drop and have no IsBusy enabled-state binding on themselves or any ancestor. Together with reviewed unguarded drop handlers, source wiring permits directory-list mutation during a scan; no live concurrency interaction performed.
Checkboxes and most filter inputs do disable while IsBusy. Date enable checkboxes bind MatchDateCreated/MatchDateModified, with date pickers gated by checkbox and busy state.

MainUserControl explicitly disables compiled bindings, so malformed binding expressions or mismatched converter types may surface at runtime rather than all being statically checked. No full application build claim.
